Chapter Two

OUR STORY

SAINT NOIR started as a print run of twelve longsleeves, screen-printed by hand in a borrowed studio and sold from the back of a car.

Every piece since has followed the same rule: cut it heavy, print it once, and never chase a trend twice. What you're wearing wasn't designed to be liked immediately — it was designed to last.
